When guests booked with Charlie on the website, the time got held but the booking never finished. After taking the name and phone number, Charlie kept saying there was a system problem, then tried a pro shop transfer the website can't do.

I ran a real web session end to end in text. Finding times and holding a time worked. Only the confirmation was refused, all four tries. The server log shows the confirm request ended before it ever reached the database.

The cause was the caller ID. On the phone, the line fills in the number. The website has none, so it arrived empty, and the server refused it as a bad field. The guest can't fix that field, so Charlie just repeated itself.

At the shared entry for every voice tool, a missing caller ID is now taken as blank, and the booking uses the number the guest says. Before the fix the new test failed with the same error; after it, all 134 tests pass.
Web Charlie no longer transfers to the pro shop or reads out its number. Anything it can't handle becomes a callback request. Phone callers can still be transferred as before.

After pushing and deploying to Fly, I tested again with a real web session. Eight ten, two players, with a cart, confirmed with a code. The test booking was cancelled right away, so nothing is left on the tee sheet.
One step is left. Applying the no-transfer rule to Charlie is blocked by auto mode and needs your approval. And the dashboard workflow skipping the member question is the next thing to fix.
